info.title: PlaneMem saved ContextPack creation and complete reads
info.description: Source-only description of the existing compile/save POST and complete saved-pack GET. Load this document plus the adjacent context-pack-read.json and context-pack-save.json schema resources locally with their full $id mappings. No server-side compiler, schema validator, client generator, build, test or API execution was performed. This is not the complete WCP API or proof of deployment.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure the actual deployment origin and base path.

tags.name: Saved ContextPack
tags.description: Explicit creation and current-authority reads of complete saved packs.

x-source-boundaries.description: Annotations only. The two legacy handlers have no dedicated 30-second/two-slot guard and do not impose the clients' 2 MiB response limit. The generic POST reader limits raw body bytes to 1 MiB before authentication. Shared client parsers apply 4 KiB query/parameters and 2 MiB success limits; client readers apply 16 KiB errors and their own deadlines. These are different enforcement layers, not server-wide guarantees.

post.summary: Create a saved ContextPack or replay the exact original save
post.description: This operation writes a saved pack, not merely a preview. Require verified Bearer identity with a nonblank authenticated client and a Policy decision for context.read; the parent project must remain readable. The handler normalizes omitted budget_tokens to 4096 and ttl_seconds to 3600, accepts at most 1000 context-item candidates, checks the bounded source graph and compiles under the selected restricted-read capability. A project transaction lock protects the version/cursor allocation, saved document/source manifest and ContextPackIssued event. Idempotency is scoped by tenant/workspace/project and the original actor/client/key; its fingerprint includes normalized parameters, restricted visibility and any legacy expected_version. Exact replay returns the existing pack only after checking its content, expiry and source dependencies again. Changed parameters/visibility produce 409, stale packs 409, expired packs 410; none creates a replacement. Success is always 200, including first creation. A transport failure after dispatch does not prove the save failed: preserve the original identity/key/parameters and use the separate save-receipt operation, never automatically rotate keys or recompile.
post.x-current-http-parser: Send application/json without query parameters or conditional headers. Existing generic POST parsing does not enforce Content-Type, reject URL query parameters, strictly reject invalid UTF-8 or check duplicate JSON keys. It parses a JSON object from a nonempty body before authentication within 1 MiB; {} is allowed. Missing/malformed/nonobject/oversize JSON returns 400 INVALID_JSON. Generic If-Match/If-Match-Version values are syntax-checked and enter the receipt fingerprint but do not perform a saved-pack compare-and-swap. These are existing gaps, not guarantees added by this document.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Preferred location for the stable original key. Required here or in body.idempotency_key; if both exist their exact strings must match. Reuse only with the original identity, normalized budget/TTL and visibility. Runtime checks 1..255 UTF-16 units and no whitespace. The current SDK applies additional C0/DEL/surrogate restrictions. Cross-header/body requirements are enforced by the handler, not this parameter schema.

requestBody.description: A JSON object is required, even when only defaults are wanted. Use {} together with Idempotency-Key for default budget/TTL. Legacy body.idempotency_key remains accepted; actor/client/scope fields are not command parameters. Neither the 4 KiB client parameter budget nor strict content encoding is enforced by this legacy HTTP handler.

200.description: Complete original saved receipt with the full pack; no rendered field. revision and JSON/header ETag describe data.version; server_cursor is the original issuance cursor, not the current stream high-water mark. The outer trace is this request's trace, while pack.trace_id remains the creation trace on replay. The response does not echo the idempotency key, original requested TTL or an explicit created-versus-replayed flag. Shared consumers additionally check digest, bounds and budget/TTL relationships.

400.description: INVALID_JSON from generic body parsing, INVALID_INPUT for unknown command fields, invalid budget/TTL, missing/disagreeing keys or invalid compile scope, INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT for malformed/disagreeing legacy version headers, or CONTEXT_SOURCE_LIMIT for more than 1000 candidates/bounded graph overflow. These errors are nonretryable; the source limit is not mapped to 413.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or rejected Bearer token; retryable=false. Early authentication does not guarantee WWW-Authenticate or an x-trace-id response header.

403.description: DENIED: unauthorized scope, expected identity mismatch, missing authenticated client or Policy denial, including expiry at authorization. retryable=false. There is no final token-expiry check in this handler after database work.

404.description: CONTEXT_PACK_NOT_FOUND: parent project is missing, deleted or outside current restricted-read visibility; retryable=false.

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED for a changed request or visibility bucket, or CONTEXT_PACK_STALE when replayed saved sources/dependencies changed or their snapshot is unavailable; retryable=false. Do not silently create a new request.

410.description: CONTEXT_PACK_EXPIRED: the existing pack for the original save is expired; retryable=false. This is not evidence that the original save failed.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED from the general actor/path limiter, retryable=true. No dedicated compile capacity code or Retry-After header is promised.

500.description: CONTEXT_PACK_INVALID for corrupt/inconsistent saved data (retryable=false) or an unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR (serializer default retryable=true). No partial success receipt is returned.

503.description: CONTEXT_PACK_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE for absent database or non-ContractError storage/handler failure; WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE or AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE at outer boundaries. These sources set retryable=true; an ambiguous dispatched request still requires original-receipt recovery.

get.summary: Read an explicit saved pack or the latest visible saved pack
get.description: Require verified Bearer scope and a Policy decision for context.read. Unlike compile and the metadata directory, this legacy HTTP read does not itself require a verified client claim; absent client claims use the existing authenticated-context fallback. A repeatable-read read-only transaction checks parent-project visibility and saved read_restricted access, then selects an explicit pack_id or the highest visible version/pack_id. Selection does not filter expiry/staleness first: an unusable latest pack returns its error rather than falling back to an older pack. checkedDocument verifies content/hash/metadata, expiry and the saved source/dependency manifest, including excluded candidates; changed or missing sources invalidate the saved result. No pack is created or refreshed. All three formats return application/json and the complete pack; markdown and mcp additionally include data.rendered with text/markdown text and a work:// URI. Format=mcp does not produce a JSON-RPC response or imply an MCP transport call.
get.x-current-http-parser: Use no GET body or write/cache/range conditions. The existing route ignores unread GET body bytes instead of explicitly rejecting them, and does not implement the directory route's forbidden-header checks. Generic version headers are syntax-checked but not evaluated against the saved pack. Conditional-cache and Range headers do not produce 304/206 or conditional reads. Only pack_id and format are accepted as single URL query fields; there is no server 4 KiB query guard here. This document does not repair those gaps.

x-response-format-schemas.description: Annotations for request-dependent validation; OpenAPI does not bind a query value to a response branch automatically.

parameters.name: pack_id
parameters.description: Exact saved pack ID; omit to select latest visible version. Empty/null/duplicate values are invalid. Explicit not-found/invisible and no visible latest pack return 404, not an empty success. The stored latest status is not the selector; version and pack_id descending determine the result.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Default json. markdown and mcp both retain the JSON envelope/full pack and add rendered; neither changes the HTTP media type. Empty or repeated values are invalid.

200.description: Complete saved receipt and full document, with optional rendered only for markdown/mcp. ETag equals the JSON etag, revision equals data.version, and server_cursor is the original issuance cursor. Outer trace belongs to this read; nested pack trace remains the creation trace. The schema does not prove current source access, digest validity, freshness at delivery or cross-request snapshot consistency. Clients additionally check the selected ID/format, full scope, source order, rendering, hash and size budget.

400.description: INVALID_INPUT for unknown/repeated query fields, invalid ID or format; INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT for malformed/disagreeing legacy version headers. retryable=false. Sending conditions is unsupported even where the parser accepts their syntax.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or rejected Bearer token; retryable=false. No early x-trace-id or WWW-Authenticate guarantee.

403.description: DENIED: scope/expected identity mismatch or Policy denial, including expiry at authorization; retryable=false. This handler does not add a post-database token-expiry check.

404.description: CONTEXT_PACK_NOT_FOUND for an unavailable parent project, invisible/absent explicit pack or no visible saved pack; retryable=false.

409.description: CONTEXT_PACK_STALE: saved candidates or dependencies changed, disappeared, exceeded current inspection bounds or lack a saved dependency snapshot; retryable=false. No older-pack fallback or automatic recompile.

410.description: CONTEXT_PACK_EXPIRED: selected pack has expired; retryable=false. Omitted pack_id still refers to the selected latest record, not latest unexpired record.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED from the general actor/path limiter, retryable=true. No dedicated read capacity limit or Retry-After header is declared.

500.description: CONTEXT_PACK_INVALID for inconsistent saved data/content/manifest/budget (retryable=false), or unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR (serializer default retryable=true).

503.description: CONTEXT_PACK_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE, WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE or AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE; retryable=true for these sources. This route has no dedicated read-timeout error.

GatewayBearer.description: Authorization: Bearer <token>, verified by the configured issuer. Scope headers constrain authorized claims (or the configured fallback project); identity/roles/capabilities come from verified claims. Policy action for both operations is context.read. Existing workbench.read/designated-client Base normalization may supply that capability; final authorization is the Policy decision, not a permission granted by this security scheme.

TenantId.name: x-tenant-id
TenantId.description: Requested tenant, exactly matching the authorized scope. Expected saved scope uses ULIDs; authentication compares the original string to its allowed claim/configuration.

WorkspaceId.name: x-workspace-id
WorkspaceId.description: Requested workspace, exactly matching the authorized scope.

ProjectId.name: x-project-id
ProjectId.description: Requested project, exactly matching the authorized scope and checked for current visibility by the handler.

TraceParent.name: traceparent
TraceParent.description: Current HTTP code treats a nonempty value as opaque and prefers it over x-trace-id; it does not parse W3C Trace Context here or require equality between both headers. Use one trace header satisfying the shared consumer requestTrace rule.

TraceId.name: x-trace-id
TraceId.description: Used when traceparent is absent/empty. If both headers are absent or empty, the server generates trace_http_<ULID>. Shared consumers constrain this value more strictly than the generic HTTP reader.

ExpectedActorId.name: x-expected-actor-id
ExpectedActorId.description: Independently optional exact equality constraint on the verified actor. It never supplies identity. HTTP comparison does not add the CLI's paired-field or identity-shape rules.

ExpectedClientId.name: x-expected-client-id
ExpectedClientId.description: Independently optional exact equality constraint on the verified client (or existing read fallback); never a credential. Compile separately requires an authenticated client claim.

NoStore.description: All application JSON responses use this policy; proxy/parser responses are outside this contract.

SuccessTrace.description: Selected inbound trace, exactly equal to outer body.trace_id. Nested pack.trace_id may differ on read or replay.

PackEtag.description: Weak saved-version tag, exactly matching body.etag and data.version. Its presence does not implement conditional GET or compare-and-swap for these operations.

ErrorTrace.description: Command-boundary errors include this header; early body/authentication/input failures may omit it. Preserve the error body's trace_id.

HttpIdempotencyKey.description: Current validateIdempotencyKey lexical rule. Runtime length counts UTF-16 units; JSON Schema counts code points. Unlike stricter original-request/SDK rules, this legacy handler does not additionally reject C0/DEL/unpaired surrogates. HTTP header encoding may restrict values further.

CompileInput.description: Only these three fields are accepted by the command. A key is mandatory in the header or body and both must agree when present; header/body coupling is not expressible in this body schema. Defaults are annotations, applied by the handler only to omitted numeric fields; null is invalid.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Existing five-field application error; details stay open. No global server 16 KiB bound is asserted. Raw HTTP retryable is distinct from client error mapping and never authorizes automatic resubmission of an ambiguous save.

Error.description: Application error, without a partial success receipt. Proxy or HTTP-parser errors before this boundary may have another representation. Status/trace and retryability are determined by the actual error source.
